    Linearity of finite-dimensional bidual evaluation #

    This verifies the load-bearing algebraic fact needed to turn the concrete contragredient functor into an equivalence: after identifying Rᵐᵒᵖᵐᵒᵖ with R, evaluation into the double dual is R-linear.
